pages.raw_meta: National Healthcare Properties offers a balanced platform focused on senior housing and outpatient medical assets, delivering disciplined growth and long-term value creation.
raw_blocks: Performance powered by a clear strategy, strong partners and healthcare assets that deliver essential care.

At National Healthcare Properties, our success is fueled by our hands-on approach to asset management and the symbiotic relationship between complementary asset classes. High-quality outpatient medical facilities with creditworthy healthcare provider tenants generate consistent performance, while strong partnerships with top industry operators and our high-quality needs-based assets propel our growth in the thriving and supply-constrained senior housing market. By leveraging the unique advantages of each asset class, we are well-positioned to capitalize on the aging of America and deliver long-term value to our shareholders.
A Balanced Approach to Healthcare Real Estate

Our dedicated team of industry experts works hand-in-hand with our leading national operators to ensure a high quality of care and strong performance. With a proven foundation, aligned partners and strong demand, we are well-positioned for dynamic growth.

Our approach is tenant-friendly yet rent-focused, structuring competitive deals while remaining focused on renewals and maximizing rental income. With long-term leases, a stable credit tenant base and high retention, this asset class delivers predictable, resilient returns.

“NHP’s commitment to strategic growth, operational collaboration and resident well-being sets a high standard in the industry. Its proactive approach and deep industry expertise makes it an ideal partner.”

pages.raw_meta: A diversified healthcare REIT focused on senior housing and outpatient medical assets, backed by a strong balance sheet and disciplined investment strategy.
raw_blocks: At National Healthcare Properties, we combine the discipline of an institutional investor with the agility and creativity of an entrepreneurial firm. As a diversified healthcare REIT, we specialize in both senior housing and outpatient medical assets—two complementary and attractive asset classes that uniquely position us to capitalize on the aging of America.

With a diverse portfolio, a strong balance sheet and favorable macroeconomic and demographic trends, we are well-positioned to pursue accretive investment opportunities and generate lasting value for our shareholders.

We pride ourselves on being both proactive and relational—partnering closely with creditworthy healthcare provider tenants and large national senior housing operators. We actively monitor our portfolio, identifying and addressing potential issues before they can escalate. By cultivating collaborative, long-term relationships, we ensure strong operational performance while supporting a high standard of care for the healthcare providers, patients and residents who rely on our properties.

pages.raw_meta: Our hands-on, relationship-driven management supports performance across a diversified portfolio of healthcare real estate assets.
raw_blocks: Diversified by Design. Positioned for Results.

Our strategically curated portfolio is an attractive blend of assets uniquely positioned to capitalize on the aging of America and the need for senior housing and outpatient medical assets—two complementary sectors that together offer stable cash flow and meaningful growth potential. This balanced mix allows us to navigate shifting market conditions, allocate capital with precision and create lasting value. Central to our approach is hands-on, relationship-driven management. We work closely with operators, tenants and healthcare partners to proactively oversee each property, address challenges early and support performance at every level.
Backed by long-term partnerships with leading operators, our portfolio is positioned to deliver stable performance and meaningful long-term growth.
Anchored by high-credit tenants and essential care delivery, our portfolio delivers stable, long-term cash flow.
3.7M Sq. Ft. of Gross Leasable Area
5.3 Years Weighted Avg. Remaining Lease Term
Two Strategies. One Goal: Strong Performance.
